Essential listening for anyone in #science & #medicine. With thanks @natashamitchell for
The whisper network: #MeToo, sexual harassment, & scientists speaking up. https://t.co/mLGUYFYOCB @RadioNational

I've spent time talking through various experiences with young women scientists who've been #sexuallyharassed by #seniors. The thing they all have in common is feeling #ashamed & #stupid for something not their fault. @natashamitchell @RadioNational #MeToo

I've also been part of the #whispernetwork, warned others when caution is sensible, asked trusted colleagues to look out for others at events I'm not at, & stayed with some to make sure they get home safely #MeToo @natashamitchell
